objects.description: Forward declaration of Dear ImGui draw list aggregation structure. Only referenced here; not defined in this header set. Purpose: carry draw commands to the text backends.

2D text-mode framebuffer owned by the ImTui namespace. Holds width (nx), height (ny), capacity (nmax), and a heap-allocated array of TCell values. Manages its own buffer lifetime (delete[] in destructor), supports clearing and resizing (reallocates when capacity insufficient).
Alias for an unsigned 8-bit character used by ImTui to represent a glyph/character in a cell. Note: semantic meaning inferred; details not documented.
Alias for an unsigned 8-bit color component in ImTui. Likely used for indexed color or low-bitdepth channels. Exact mapping undocumented here.
Packed 32-bit cell value combining character code (low 16 bits), foreground color (next 8 bits), and background color (top 8 bits). Used as elements of TScreen::data.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplText_Init
functions.description: Initializes the ImTui text-mode rendering backend. Call this once before using other ImTui_ImplText_* functions to set up internal state/resources.
requirements: Must be called before ImTui_ImplText_NewFrame and ImTui_ImplText_RenderDrawData.
Should be paired with ImTui_ImplText_Shutdown to release resources.
Return value should be checked; false indicates initialization failure.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplText_Shutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the ImTui text-mode rendering backend and releases any resources allocated by ImTui_ImplText_Init.
requirements: Should only be called after a successful ImTui_ImplText_Init.
After calling, no other ImTui_ImplText_* calls should be made unless re-initialized.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplText_NewFrame
functions.description: Begins a new frame for the ImTui text-mode backend. Prepare per-frame state before issuing ImGui drawing and rendering via this backend.
requirements: ImTui_ImplText_Init must have been called successfully prior to the first call.
Should be called once per frame before generating/using ImDrawData for rendering with this backend.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplText_RenderDrawData
functions.description: Renders Dear ImGui draw data into a text-mode screen buffer (ImTui::TScreen). Takes the ImGui-generated ImDrawData and writes the result into the provided screen.
requirements: drawData must be a valid pointer to ImDrawData produced for the current frame (typically via ImGui::Render).
screen must be a non-null pointer to an initialized ImTui::TScreen with nx, ny set and an allocated data buffer sized for at least nx*ny cells (e.g., via TScreen::resize).
ImTui_ImplText_Init must have been called before rendering.
The function does not allocate the TScreen buffer; caller is responsible for sizing/clearing the screen as desired before the call.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init
functions.signature: ImTui::TScreen * ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init(bool mouseSupport, float fps_active = 60.0, float fps_idle = -1.0);
functions.description: Initializes the ncurses-based I/O backend for ImTui and returns a text screen object used for drawing. Allows configuring different redraw rates for active vs. idle states and optional mouse support.
requirements: mouseSupport controls whether mouse input is enabled; pass true to enable, false to disable.
fps_active specifies the redraw rate (frames per second) when the application is active; should be positive for a limited rate.
fps_idle specifies the redraw rate when idle; a negative value (default -1.0) indicates no idle limit per the comment, while a positive value sets an idle FPS.
Return value must be checked for null to detect initialization failure.
The returned ImTui::TScreen pointer must be used with this backend's draw calls; ownership/lifetime management is not documented in the header (unknown).

functions.name: ImTui_ImplNcurses_Shutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the ncurses backend and releases resources created by ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init.
requirements: Should be called after a successful ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init and when the backend is no longer needed.
Do not call other ImTui_ImplNcurses_* functions after shutdown unless re-initialized.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplNcurses_NewFrame
functions.description: Processes input and advances to a new frame for the ncurses backend. Returns true if there was any keyboard/mouse input during this frame.
requirements: ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init must have been called successfully before the first call.
Call once per frame before rendering/drawing the screen.
The boolean return indicates presence of user input; caller may use this to decide active vs. idle update behavior.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplNcurses_DrawScreen
functions.description: Draws the current screen to the terminal using ncurses at a rate controlled by active/idle FPS settings. The active flag selects between fps_active and fps_idle configured at initialization.
requirements: ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init must have been called successfully before use.
active selects which redraw rate to apply: true uses fps_active; false uses fps_idle.
Should typically be called once per frame after rendering to the screen buffer.

functions.name: ImTui_ImplNcurses_ProcessEvent
functions.description: Processes pending input events for the ncurses backend. Returns true if an event was processed. Exact event semantics are not documented in the header (unknown).
requirements: ImTui_ImplNcurses_Init must have been called successfully before use.
Caller should check the boolean return to determine if any event was handled.
Specific event types and side effects are not documented (unknown).
